# InboundOnSteroids

> LinkedIn content and outreach for agency founders, built and run by Ivan Manfredi. The full service starts at $3,000 a month, and each extra team account adds $1,000 a month. There is no setup fee, no minimum term and no notice period. Outreach goes out from the client's own LinkedIn account and replies are handled through to a booked call. Ivan works only with agency founders, 10 at a time, and has helped 50+ brands, with $2M in client revenue generated and $50M in pipeline built.

## Services

- [AI outreach systems for agencies](https://inboundonsteroids.com/ai-outbound-systems-for-agencies/): who builds them, how the system works step by step, pricing and booked-call results
- [LinkedIn outreach services](https://inboundonsteroids.com/linkedin-outreach-services/): buyer research, messages and conversations
- [LinkedIn inbound lead generation](https://inboundonsteroids.com/linkedin-inbound-lead-generation/): posts, lead magnets and resources
